job.brief: Example mapped into contract v0.4 from the figures in Paul's handoff review of 13 November 2026. It shows one job holding a subdivision and two townhouse alternatives side by side. The job record is a placeholder: no order-form record exists for this job.

level1.summary: Three alternatives are documented: a seven-lot subdivision with one road lot, 36 two-bedroom townhouses, or 27 three-bedroom townhouses. They are alternatives and are never added together. Each is the highest yield tested, not a verified maximum, and each carries planning, engineering and legal holds.

open_items.summary: No option has been selected. The subdivision and the two townhouse schemes are alternatives: 36 and 27 are never added to make 63.
No recorded sign-off from Paul. The reports are generated, not issued.
Obtain title 499340, DP 425172, all instruments, property file and a boundary/topographic survey. No title instruments supplied.
Confirm current consolidated rules, legal effect, DEV-RO2 / ODP Area 9 links, staging, density and any upgrades with a planner.
Council acceptance of road class, vesting, cul-de-sac/connectivity, arterial junction, sightlines, crossings, gradients and complete tracking remains unverified.
Flood certificate, floor levels, overland flow, storage, earthworks, groundwater, geotechnical and contamination advice remain outstanding.
Confirm lawful stormwater outfall, water/wastewater capacity and connection points, levels, easements and fire supply. Map proximity does not authorise a connection.
No finished dwelling floor plans. Gross/net floor areas, bathrooms, room layouts, bedroom outlook, glazing, shading, privacy and final materials are unverified.
Classify irregular lots and possible rear sites/access strips; curved road contact is not proof of compliant access.
Land-use/subdivision/engineering/building approvals and s223/s224 title processes are not established.
The source study contains no supplied purchase price, build rates, sale prices, DCs, finance costs, profit or programme. Do not infer them.
Net site area is not confirmed, so every coverage percentage uses a provisional denominator.
